lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Visible as a non-uniform grid of high-luminance circular spots. The highest-intensity clusters are arranged in approximately five horizontal rows and eight vertical columns on the mid-lateral flank, with spacing expanding towards the posterior.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with horizontal axes of high-luminance blobs. These intersections form distinct anchor nodes, where the highest luminance values are concentrated within the grid structure.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three primary horizontal linear features are visible on the upper third of the flank. Each is characterized by a high-luminance upper ridge and a sharp vertical transition to a high-shadow lower trough.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The visible portion of the first dorsal fin displays a dense distribution of small, circular, high-luminance blobs, primarily concentrated along the leading edge and middle third of the fin's macro-mask.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A distinct labyrinthine or vermiculate white pattern is visible on the lateral flank immediately posterior to the gill slits, differing significantly in morphology from the surrounding circular spot patterning.
other_distinctive_markers: A high-intensity yellow-green linear object, consistent with a synthetic tag or tethered debris, is visible near the posterior trailing edge of the pectoral fin. Multiple commensal fish silhouettes (remoras) are visible in the immediate vicinity of the ventral-lateral flank.
